description: Use this when someone wants mining companies, projects or properties by commodity and place, or by company: e.g. "gold companies in the Yukon", "copper properties in British Columbia", lithium in Nevada, gold in Australia, a company's properties, or properties whose name contains a word. Give it any of a name, a commodity, a place (a country, or a province, state or territory), or a company. Returns every company with at least one such property, each with its properties and where each is (as the company's own releases print it), newest news first (6ix never ranks them), counted; each property's commodities, place, how many estimates, studies and drill releases 6ix lists, and its 6ix.com page; and the Markets › Properties page that shows the same list. get_mineral_project gives one property's figures.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

country.description: The country's English name: Canada, United States, Australia…

limit.description: How many properties structuredContent.properties lists; companies always lists every company

region.description: A province, state or territory: Yukon, British Columbia, Quebec, Nevada, Western Australia…

name: find_mineral_projects

page.description: Markets › Properties on 6ix.com, narrowed the same way

title: Find mineral properties
